summary: About a quarter of the inventoried elements match the prototype outright (user/assistant message shell, the Call(child) title+question shape used by subagent_call/result, routing_decision text, the honest-placeholder/no-silent-fallback policy for unrenderable and unshipped kinds). The worst gaps: tool_call+tool_result never fold into the prototype's single collapsible row — both render fully expanded, permanently, with mismatched wrench/gear icons, and long tool errors are silently truncated at 120 chars into a dangling fragment; the entire artifact-chip grid (28px teal icon tile cards) is unimplemented anywhere in the transcript; the child-result card renders with cursor:pointer but has no click handler at all, so the prototype's 'open the focused agent transcript' interaction is both missing (the pane doesn't exist) and not-wired (the affordance lies); and the running/failed color semantics on child cards are backwards against the prototype's convention (StatusDot's 'running' is success-green, and a live-observed failed delegation still renders the neutral gray 'idle' dot).

items.element: Tool invocation row — fold/collapse behavior ('tool_result folds inside expandable')
items.proto_truth: ONE row per tool call: '{name}({argHint})  …  {meta}  {✓/✗ mark}  ▸chevron', collapsed by default; clicking toggles a bordered 'well' box showing the full params/results 2-column grid. While collapsed, an optional 1-line preview of the first result key/value still shows. design/prototype/Clio Session.html:391 (isToolSeg block).
items.fix_hint: tool_call and tool_result render as two SEPARATE, permanently-expanded PartCards — no chevron, no toggle, no collapse exists at all. Merge them into one collapsible card keyed by the call id, closed by default, with the ✓/✗ mark + duration meta on the header row.

items.element: Tool call vs tool result gutter icon
items.proto_truth: The SAME wrench glyph (path 'M7.9 1.6a2.9…') is used for the call and its result — one icon per tool row, not two.
items.fix_hint: tool_call correctly uses the 'wrench' icon; tool_result uses 'tool' (a borrowed 24x24 gear/settings glyph) instead — live-confirmed as a visibly different icon stacked directly under the wrench. Use 'wrench' for both, or drop the icon on the result row since it's the same tool.

items.proto_truth: Full stderr/traceback lines in a dedicated 'tail' well box, or a clean key/value results grid — nothing is silently cut mid-token.
items.fix_hint: Live-observed on a real failed geo_geocode call: the MCPError message is truncated to 120 chars via the generic shortScalar helper, ending mid-object as "...{'support...". Render tool_result error text in full (own well box), not through the summary-table truncator.

items.element: Call(child) title + indented question (subagent_call / subagent_result path)
items.proto_truth: Bold 'Call(child)' heading (600 weight, 14px), question paragraph hanging at margin-left 18px, prose 14px/1.6.

Same Call() grammar as subagent_call: title, optional expandable call-params, question, THEN a separate child-summary card with header row (name↑, host in accent mono 10.5px, duration top-right) and a 3-line-clamp body excerpt.
items.fix_hint: Live-observed (LA ground motion session): this code path takes a shortcut that skips the Call() title AND the question text entirely, rendering only a bare compact card (StatusDot + child_agent name + run_label). Host and duration are never extracted or shown. Route this stage through the same HandoffPart grammar used for subagent_call/result instead of a second, thinner card shape.

items.proto_truth: In-progress indicators are ALWAYS accent orange var(--t-ac,#c4682a) with clio-pulse; var(--t-ok,#34d399) green is reserved for completed-successfully states, never for 'still running'.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/kit/statusdot.css:22-26 (running = rgb(52,211,153), i.e. var(--t-ok) green); apps/web/src/transcript/registry.tsx:156; contrast apps/web/src/transcript/parts/parts.css:212-219 (part-childcard__dot correctly uses var(--t-ac))
items.fix_hint: StatusDot's 'running' state uses the SUCCESS green, not the in-progress accent orange the prototype uses everywhere else for pulsing/live state — live-confirmed on the 'geospatial' child card while it was running. This also means the app now has two Call-card code paths that disagree with each other on the color for the same semantic state (HandoffPart's own dot is correctly orange).

items.proto_truth: Failures are marked red/var(--t-er,#f87171) with a ✗ mark throughout the prototype (tool marks, hitl deny states, run-history badges) — a failed child is never visually identical to a successful one.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/transcript/registry.tsx:156 (status hardcoded to 'running'|'idle', never 'error'); apps/web/src/kit/statusdot.css:34-38 (an 'error' state exists and is unused here)
items.backend_surface: message.part.expert_handoff — no success/failure signal reaches the renderer for this stage
items.fix_hint: Live-observed: a session where the narration text explicitly says the geospatial child 'fully failed (delegate.failed, error_reason=agent_error)' still renders that child's card with the plain gray 'idle' dot, identical to a normal completion. Thread the delegate's terminal status into StatusDot's status prop (StatusDot already supports 'error').

items.backend_surface: unbacked — no per-child focused-transcript view or route exists in apps/web/src

Two things are needed: (1) an onClick handler, and (2) the destination itself — no 'focused agent transcript' pane exists anywhere in the app (grepped apps/web/src for an equivalent of the prototype's inFocus/fv.parts view; none found). Tracked by the open 'E9 — new Call-agent grammar' work item.
